# Tempo Partnership


Infinite is excited to join the Tempo ecosystem as an infrastructure partner.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


December 9, 2025


·


1 min read


Partnerships


**We're excited to join Tempo ecosystem (incubated by**[Stripe](https://stripe.com/) **and**[Paradigm](https://paradigm.xyz/) **) as an infrastructure partner.** Global money movement is still broken: multi-day settlement, opaque fees, and high-friction compliance.


Stablecoins are a 10x improvement for global commerce, but only if enterprises can actually adopt them compliantly.


We're here to help merchant developers in the Tempo ecosystem go live with turnkey global stablecoin payments and compliance in days, not weeks, through enterprise-grade compliance and ramp orchestration.


If you’re a business exploring stablecoins or[Tempo](https://tempo.xyz/ecosystem) to move money onchain,[reach out to learn more](https://infinite.net/book-a-demo) .
